description: Permutation test that the empirical eigenvalue spectrum differs from the column-scrambled null, targeting the top of the spectrum.
null_hypothesis: genes are mutually independent (no gene-gene correlation)
null_construction: independent permutation of each gene (column) across cells; reproduces src/analysis_functions.scramble

parameters.z_transform: column-wise, ddof=0 -> (1/n)M'M is the Pearson correlation matrix with trace exactly p
parameters.eigen_solver: numpy.linalg.eigvalsh on the n x n Gram matrix (1/n)MM'

statistics.z_k: (lambda_obs[k] - null_mean[k]) / null_sd[k], null moments from the B replicates
statistics.maxT: max over k<=20 of z_k, maximized within each replicate (FWER control across ranks)
statistics.k_hat: parallel analysis: number of leading eigenvalues above the null 95th percentile at their own rank
